title: Pocket Dribble to Pass
description: Ball handlers practise picking the ball up into the 'pocket' on the hip at the end of a drive and passing in one motion, instead of holding it in front of the defender.

content.objective: Gather the ball on the hip at the end of a dribble and deliver a one-handed pass without exposing it.
content.setup: Driver at the top, shooters in both corners.
content.organization: Drive, pass, rotate to the corner you passed to.
instructions: Drive toward the elbow with the right hand.
On the last dribble, gather the ball up into the right hip pocket.
Pass one-handed from the pocket to the right corner shooter.
The shooter catches and shoots; the driver replaces the shooter.
Repeat to the left with the left hand.
coachingPoints: Gather on the hip, not in front of the chest.
Pass with a wrist flick from the pocket.
Keep driving with the eyes up to see the shooter.
commonMistakes: Bringing the ball to the chest and telegraphing the pass.
content.safety: Shooters rebound their own ball; next driver waits for the corner to clear.
progressions: A defender stunts at the driver.
Choose corner or wing shooter based on a help defender.
variations: Pass to a rolling screener instead of the corner.
successCriteria: Pass arrives on the shooter's shooting pocket.
Ball never comes above the waist before the pass.
content.gameApplication: Pocket passes at the end of drives are quicker to deliver and harder to read than chest passes.
